# Wave 2 Validation Guide

**Status**: Prospective Phase 1 run guide, not executed Wave 2 acceptance. No implementation or test suites are generated by this plan. Follow [plan.md](plan.md), [data-model.md](data-model.md), [HTTP](contracts/http.md) and [transaction](contracts/transactions.md) contracts. All data must be synthetic.

## Prerequisites

- Explicit assignment of an existing Master Task and verified evidence for exactly its direct dependencies. Use the [Wave 1 task records](../002-wave-1-security-core/tasks.md) and [latest relevant executable CI records](../002-wave-1-security-core/quickstart.md); historical status summaries alone are insufficient.
- Repository-pinned standard-GIL Python 3.13.16/pip 26.2.2, Node 24.22.1 and pnpm 10.34.7 on PATH; existing reviewed Python and pnpm locks. Use the existing environment, not system Python of another version or a regenerated lock.
- For implementation verification, install the existing lock only as documented by the repository: `python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements.lock` and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. This planning pass does not install anything or change pins.
- Existing `.env.example`, CI secret bootstrap and explicitly labeled synthetic policy configuration. Required production policy must remain absent/fail-closed, not populated with test recommendations. Do not print credentials, signed envelopes, patient data or Doctor narrative in logs/artifacts.
- Docker-capable Linux CI owns disposable PostgreSQL 17.11/Compose. **Do not install, probe or require local Docker.** No production database or populated user environment is a test target.

## Existing runnable entrypoints

From repository root, run the checks relevant to the actual implemented change:

```powershell
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 inputs
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 python-quality
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 unit
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 imports
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 web
```

Expected: approved pins/locks/peers and installed closure pass; Python quality/unit checks pass; imports and route/purpose allowlists match only authorized routes; single compatible Alembic head; TypeScript/ESLint/Next.js 15.5.28 production build passes when the BFF is affected. During implementation extend existing checks to the new owned suites/routes/head, retaining all prior security assertions. A current baseline pass proves **no Wave 2 behavior**.

Use `.github/workflows/foundation.yml` on the implementation SHA via its PR/manual trigger; do not assume a feature-branch push runs it. In the existing bootstrapped CI environment, with `CI=true`, `RUNNER_OS=Linux`, PowerShell 7 and matching disposable `CP_CI_PROJECT`/`COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`, the integration entrypoint is:

```powershell
pwsh -File ./ops/check.ps1 integration
```

The existing entrypoint currently enumerates Wave 1 suites. Before claiming new acceptance, register each owning Wave 2 suite in that same command, require its presence/collection/execution and reject skipped mandatory evidence. Wire any changed CI input fingerprints through the existing reviewed process, never disable them. No new runner/framework is needed. Record actual commands, test counts, SHA, run URL and logs; a green command that did not collect the new cases is not evidence.

## Per-master synthetic validation scenarios

Implement functionality first, then focused tests. Each row requires its successful path and meaningful denial; applicable races use independent database connections with observable lock coordination, not sleeps or mocked transactions. Foundation fixtures exercise persistence only and must satisfy all installed invariants.

| Master | Setup and action | Expected observable result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D-06 | Seed valid dated Waiting Appointments/entries in MAIN and EMERGENCY; simulate competing capacity transitions across dates; exercise scoped confirmations and revocation/expiry checks. | One QueueDay/date/lane; exactly one active matching entry for each Waiting record and none for others; capacity one admits at most one simulated additional examination across all partitions. Wrong target/day/lane/revision, expired/revoked/consumed confirmation and Receptionist/operator revoke deny. Original arrivals/ranks/cursor remain intact. Does not require D-07 or publish admission routes. |
| D-07 | Seed valid admission-associated Appointment/Visit evidence; attempt a second Visit or creation from Booked/Waiting; correct retained Completed/exceptionally Cancelled clinical content as Doctor. | Exactly one Visit/admission, none from booking/check-in; retained terminal Visit never reopens Appointment. Immutable old/new correction, Doctor actor/role and second-precision time; Both live staff roles may insert a structural shell as the matching genuine admission-history actor, with NULL clinical fields/decision and revision 0; clinical content on INSERT, inactive/foreign actors, missing context, operator and forged admission provenance fail. Clinical UPDATE/authorship remains Doctor-only and audited; Receptionist clinical output remains excluded by role projections. Does not require D-06. |
| D-08 | Use Completed Routine/Emergency/Urgent New Examination sources and synthetic preferential lifecycles; race new reservations, completion/cancellation and deadline decisions. | One active claim/source, one ever-Completed consumption; release inseparable from valid Cancelled/No-show, including exceptional In Examination cancel retaining Visit. Forced failure releases/consumes nothing. A later claim uses current eligibility/price, not a revived terminal record. |
| D-11 | Seed multiple original dates, all six statuses, retained cancelled Visits and DayReview revisions; move deterministic time across Cairo midnight; inspect actual query plans. | No automatic status/date/lane mutation; final close cannot retain unresolved Waiting or end an in-progress Visit. Review amendments audited separately. Tenant/date/status/lane/family paths retain independent patient identities; Completed value/query basis distinguishes service day from event day. No report/reconciliation API. |
| B-06 | Owner sets prices and changes policy; staff apply valid none/fixed/percentage/free non-Urgent options. Race standard/Urgent policy edits and price confirmation. | 100.00 minus 10.00 or 10% = 90.00; 10.05 at 50% = 5.03 after one final half-up round. Unset remains unset. Reject negative/nonfinite/above-base/forged totals/missing reason, Free Urgent and Urgent base or rounded net <= standard. Enabled Urgent requires valid periods. Snapshot observes one complete policy and never changes later. Receptionist/operator settings write denied. |
| B-07 | Inspect defaults; configure weekly periods, overrides, holidays, breaks and explicit cutoff; preview changes against Open and timed bookings, then confirm a new conflicting booking before activation. | Open/no invented hours/cap/cutoff. Holiday OFF denies ordinary booking; ON permits eligible Open but supplies no timed hours. Explicit date opening required for holiday Exact-Time. Preview shows affected records; stale/conflicting activation fails, neither cancels/reschedules nor reprices. Cutoff enable without valid explicit time fails; saving valid configuration changes no states and starts no scheduler. |
| B-08 | Offer manual and generated candidates; test period-start anchors, break/work bounds and remainders, adjacent/partial-overlap intervals, overlap capacity and known Cairo IANA gap/fold dates with deterministic clocks. | For synthetic 09:00–11:20, duration 30 minutes and break 09:40–09:50, offer 09:00–09:30, 10:00–10:30 and 10:30–11:00 before manual suppression; no 09:50 restart or short trailing slot. Each separate applicable period anchors its own grid. Suppress every generated/manual intersection; manual candidate still validated. `[09:00,09:30)` and `[09:30,10:00)` coexist. Invalid periods/duration, gaps and unresolved folds fail; a uniquely resolving valid offset/instant succeeds retaining service date. Capacity uses peak simultaneous occupancy, not count of all intersecting records; concurrent confirmations cannot oversubscribe. |
| B-09 | Both authorized roles select separate active family patients and confirm Routine New Examination. Race duplicate patient/day, different patients' day numbers, archive, policy activation and identical keys; inject rollback and lost response after commit. | Booked only, unique shared clinic/day number, frozen EGP/history/receipt/outbox; zero Visits or active entries. Counted Completed blocks; Cancelled/No-show allow distinct ID/number. Archive winner blocks new ID; booking winner survives later archive. Retry returns original authorized result; changed body 409; revoked session cannot recover receipt. Unknown outcome resolves original result before another mutation. Pause/walk-in OFF do not block ordinary booking or permit fused attendance. |
| B-10 | Seed valid Completed sources, Doctor decision and completion-local date; book days 7/8; race two claims, source eligibility edits/extensions and release/consume. Test future policy edits and submitted `expected_source_revision` under source locks after day-counter allocation. | Completion 1 November permits 8 November inclusive, not 9 November absent justified Doctor exception. Same patient/Doctor/clinic, New Examination source only. Frozen source/deadline/authorization/price survive future changes. Separate prior Doctor extension permits a later reschedule owner to validate a move; extension does not move/reprice. Consumed/ineligible request becomes ordinary New Examination only through all ordinary guards; no orphan/recursive claim. Busy active reservation cannot become a second preferential claim. Missing source revision for a referenced reviewed source is 422; a stale revision rejects both preferential and acknowledged fallback confirmation with 409 and no committed effects; identical committed receipts still recover before new-work checks. Receptionist receives operational eligibility only, not narrative/Doctor decision contents. |

CHK008 B-07/B-08 checks: weekly manual slots apply without a date-specific set; a configured date-specific set replaces, not merges with, the weekly set for that date. Verify both selected sets against applicable work/break/holiday guards; replacement supplies no opening and only valid effective manual candidates suppress generated intersections. Generation retains its period-start grid. Preview recurring and date-specific edits and preserve existing confirmed intervals. These are prospective checks, not executed evidence.

CHK006/CHK005 consistency: every timed-capacity preview check means the effective booking limit, 1 with overlap OFF or current saved examination capacity with overlap ON. Verify disabling overlap while overlapping bookings remain is a conflict. Schedule writes cannot change saved CAPACITY or a separate booking limit; later B-14 controls retain their own immediate-control contract.

CHK013 D-08/B-10 checks: accept justified specific Doctor deadlines equal to/after source Cairo completion, including below day seven and beyond it without a maximum duration; reject before-completion dates, missing justification and unauthorized actors. Verify source edits cannot reduce existing confirmed entitlement and separate confirmed-target extensions cannot shorten it. Use valid synthetic source/claim records and retained protected audit. These are prospective checks, not executed evidence.

CHK014 D-08/B-10 checks: source already Completed at confirmation; intended completion day zero qualifies through the authorized deadline, earlier dates never qualify even under an exception/extension. Same-source-service-day counted uniqueness still denies a second appointment. For an older original service date completing after midnight today, today's booking may qualify if no other counted appointment or ordinary guard blocks it; preserve both dates. Exercise lower-bound equality/before-bound denial and all normal date/start/slot/archive/authorization checks without new clinical output. These are prospective checks, not executed evidence.

CHK002 B-08/B-09/B-10 checks: with a deterministic Cairo clock, separate active patients and otherwise valid configuration, request availability and confirm Open and Exact-Time dates 366 and 3,650 calendar days ahead. No maximum horizon may deny them; these dates are examples, not new limits. Repeat representative invalid calendar/slot/capacity/access cases to verify distance does not bypass guards. An intended preferential date after its authorized deadline does not qualify; any New Examination fallback still requires ordinary-price acknowledgment and discount reaffirmation. Past-date/passed-start rejection is unchanged; no later-wave command is required. These are prospective checks, not executed evidence.

CHK011 B-06 checks: both booking roles use reasoned finite percentages 0, 100, 12.345 and 0.500000000000000000000000000001 under existing request safeguards. On non-Urgent bases 100.00 and 1.00 respectively, the latter two give 87.66 and 0.99; exact percentage value survives quote, confirmation, stored snapshot, operational read and same-key recovery after settings change. Exercise a valid value with many leading fractional zeros to catch scale loss as well as coefficient precision loss. No percentage digit cap or silent quantization is allowed; EGP bases/fixed discounts/final net retain their existing precision. Negative, above-100/nonfinite, missing-reason and Urgent premium failures remain atomic; zero-base PERCENT still needs a reason. Verify existing D-05 validation/NUMERIC/serialization compatibility without rewriting history or adding a new storage path. These are prospective checks, not executed evidence.

These foundation checks do **not** deliver B-11–20. Their later actual check-in/admission/completion/cancel/reschedule/No-show commands must prove their own integration, including claim release/consumption. Conflicting schedule activation may legitimately remain blocked until authorized resolution exists. No fixture/maintenance transition may ship as an operational shortcut.

**Pre-task review additions (not executed):** Apply the [spec clarification answers](spec.md#clarifications) and [transaction race outcomes](contracts/transactions.md#required-race-outcomes) to the owning rows above. B-09/B-10 reject past Cairo dates and passed starts without adding lead time; B-08 requires exact current unsuppressed candidate endpoints. B-07 mode changes preserve prior Open/timed records and preview slot/duration/overlap changes. The approved 2026-10-28 P5 rule blocks proposed date/operating-period/break invalidation for future `Booked`/`Waiting`, including Waiting-only dates; `In Examination`/`Completed` are not retroactively invalidated by those edits. All four counted timed statuses contribute to peak on future dates even with no `Booked` or overlap change; proposed effective limit below actual peak blocks activation. Cutoff exposure is `Booked`-only; no appointment is automatically changed. CHK006 adds overlap enablement checks: configured Exact-Time slots, explicit current saved integer capacity >=2 and its revision; missing confirmation/capacity 1/invalid values deny, stale evidence conflicts. Use test-only valid saved CAPACITY records, not a Wave 2 capacity-setting route. B-08 accepts peak equal to saved examination capacity and rejects excess/concurrent oversubscription, with no separate booking cap; booking neither supplies admission approval nor changes existing records. B-06 proves both-role operational quote access without Receptionist settings/Doctor content access, zero preferential base with NONE (`is_free=true`, no discount reason), and stale-revision/quote denial rather than silent substitution. B-10 requires actual ordinary type/net acknowledgment and explicit NONE/FIXED/PERCENT discount reaffirmation before fallback; missing acknowledgment or later price/source/schedule changes reject atomically. Busy source remains 409 without fallback. Check each exposed mutation's required key, original receipt recovery after policy changes, and lost-key unverifiable outcome staying blocked. Fixture setup stays test-only with no route/purpose/public command. Final CHK002/011 expected outcomes are now explicit above and in the spec/contracts; [booking-review.md](checklists/booking-review.md) records their document-quality review. Stop for independent review before task generation; this guide claims no executed acceptance.

**Post-review status (2026-10-28):** The preceding instruction to stop for independent review records the earlier handoff. That review has now passed without a demonstrated BLOCKER/MAJOR, and Issue #19 is closed as completed. This guide still contains prospective checks only; task generation and implementation require separate authorization.

## Cross-cutting database, failure and access checks

Apply to each changed owner's actual tables/command boundary, not only eventual D-12/B-27:

1. **Migration upgrades**: seed representative compatible synthetic rows at each new migration's immediately preceding revision, upgrade with the migration role, and compare retained identifiers, links, snapshots, assignments, clinical/history evidence, policy versions and original dates. Test fresh install, repeat upgrade and one intentional transactional failure; failure must not advance Alembic falsely or expose a partially changed schema. Earlier representative data incompatible with a required invariant must cause safe refusal, not deletion or invented repair. Preserve published revisions. D-07 successful predecessor fixtures have no prior admission and satisfy installed invariants; incompatible admitted/Completed or admitted exceptionally Cancelled records without required evidence must safely refuse. Cover all six statuses after installation with legitimate history/Visit evidence, never fabricated predecessor history.
2. **Effective security**: two tenants, missing/invalid context, pooled connection reuse after rollback, cross-tenant composite FKs, operator/no-DDL denials and explicit role-safe output/input projections. Inspect actual grants, functions, views and FORCE RLS. Any necessary privileged helper has fixed safe search_path, narrow EXECUTE and no client-selected role/tenant bypass. Receptionist must not gain Doctor narrative via nested fields, previews, histories, saved receipts or errors.
3. **Atomicity/failure**: inject SQL error, lock timeout/deadlock and connection/dependency loss at relevant boundaries; inspect all related rows, counters, assignments, snapshot, claim, history, audit, receipt and outbox after recovery. Failed domain operations leave zero successful effects; separate durable verified nonce/security-denial evidence is allowed. Check pool context is cleared. An unknown commit outcome is not rollback: use original authorized receipt/resource reconciliation before retry, with a fresh signed nonce.
4. **Bounded work**: malformed/unknown/forged fields, invalid money/dates/intervals and excessive input fail predictably within existing transport policy; lists use capped stable cursors. Check tenant-scoped representative PostgreSQL EXPLAIN plans for changed patient/date/status/lane/report foundations. Add only demonstrated necessary indexes; no invented load targets or patient limits.
5. **Concurrency outcomes**: verify both lock winners where outcomes differ, and assert final database state, not merely response status. Keep master lock order; no external network/file work under locks. No pre-commit notification or Wave 4 delivery claim.

Issue [#13](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/13) separately covers older populated intermediate upgrade/restore evidence before deployment/D-12. It does not excuse a missing new Wave 2 predecessor-upgrade test.

## Evidence and exit

For each of the **nine** masters retain task ID, assigned scope, changed files/migration IDs, dependency evidence, relevant W2-FR/US/SC and approved FR/BR/INV/CON/AC anchors, actual commands/results, executable SHA, CI URL and artifacts. Independently inspect the diff and failures. Preserve evidence in existing task/PR records when task generation/implementation is separately authorized; do not create tasks now.

Wave 2 exit requires [master §§7/11.4/13.3](../../docs/implementation-plan.md) and spec SC-001–008, including policy/slot/booking/claim races and stable upgrades. IMPLEMENTED, TESTED and INTEGRATION VERIFIED remain distinct; missing real PostgreSQL/Compose or required BFF evidence is BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED. D-12/B-27 supplement, never postpone focused checks. After two unsuccessful fixes of one failure, stop with reproduction/expected/actual/evidence and a proposed bounded action.

Open Issues [#2](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/2), [#4](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/4), [#5](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/5), [#13](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/13) and [#18](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/issues/18) retain the owners/triggers/closure evidence summarized in [plan.md](plan.md#material-deferred-obligations). They do not block this planning pass. Required production security numerics, backups/recovery/legal and files policies remain OPEN; synthetic success is not PRODUCTION READY, real-user/patient authorization or a non-billed-pilot exemption.

### B-08 - Test-only Cairo ZoneInfo regression correction (2026-10-30; superseding CI evidence)

- **Supersedes, preserves history:** The preceding B-08 test/CI evidence at implementation SHA `3fa6f8105bdab6643c4be47f912a8d438f9af65d`, [Foundation #40969015822](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/actions/runs/40969015822), and documentary commit `a733b052d9ce5775e24ead32383a68316394e649` remains above as historical evidence. - **Finding and exactly scoped fix:** Only `tests/integration/test_slot_races.py` changed. The parametrized PostgreSQL timezone regression had hard-coded `timedelta(hours=2)` even though dynamic `SERVICE_DAY` can fall during Cairo DST (UTC+03:00). The test now derives the start and end local offsets from the service-day slot instants using actual `ZoneInfo('Africa/Cairo')`; it asserts their Cairo service date, checks PostgreSQL returns Cairo-offset `timestamptz` after `SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo'`, and verifies the returned timestamps convert back to the exact canonical UTC instants. Existing `list_slots` availability and `validate_timed_booking` conflict behavior remain asserted for overlap enabled and disabled. No production code, contract, dependency, migration, runtime/CI configuration, or unrelated test changed.

### D-07 — Visit and immutable clinical revisions (2026-11-02; implementation and verification record)

- **Authorized scope:** T057–T066 only. Alembic 0021_d07_visits (after 0020_b07_manual_slot_weekly) creates public.visits and public.clinical_revisions with tenant-scoped composite foreign keys and uniqueness, immutable admission identity, clinical revisions from actual OLD/NEW row images, a deferred Appointment/Visit consistency guard, and safe migration preflight. Runtime may insert an empty Visit on genuine Waiting → In Examination evidence as live actor (Doctor/Owner or Receptionist), while only the enabled verified Doctor matching that Visit may change clinical content. Runtime cannot directly write clinical_revisions; both tables use FORCE RLS and have no operator grants. SQLAlchemy metadata, API/Web readiness and the existing Wave 2 test fixtures were updated. No D-06 queue dependency, D-08 functionality or operational endpoint was introduced.
- **Exact executable SHA and verified CI:** [Foundation #41461708889](https://github.com/ahmedali5696/care-pulse-3/actions/runs/41461708889) ran against 58b7eeac8688a7bc3b39d3ae2b3860eebf91b8fe with status=completed, conclusion=success.
